cause: the two precomputes were run concurrently; showdown_tonight writes state/proj/draws/worlds to per-TAG paths and copies them into the scenario afterwards, so the runs read each other's intermediates. Both produced the byte-identical upload; the Daniels state carries Mayfield as starter with no OUT designation.
fix: showdown_next_slate.run now takes an exclusive per-tag lock (CONCURRENT_RUN_SAME_TAG) and refuses SCENARIO_STATE_MISMATCH when the built state does not carry the scenario's own designations and starters. Reruns in sequence as PRECOMPUTE_TBQB_DANIELS_R3 and PRECOMPUTE_TBQB_MAYFIELD_R2.
kept_as_evidence: directories, ledgers and write-once freezes are left in place unchanged
